verdict.rationale: Fly.io describes org-wide service connections for Sprites, where credentials are injected rather than pasted, can be scoped per Sprite, label, or endpoint, and rotate centrally. It also offers Managed Postgres and encrypted secrets passed to apps. This is credential brokering and env-style secrets rather than in-code native bindings, it is shown mainly for the Sprites/agent product, and one user reports Postgres failing to link to their app when following the guide. missing for 10: documented code-level bindings for databases/storage/APIs on regular Fly Apps, a first-party object storage binding, details on how the Sprite service-connection feature works, independent corroboration of smooth database attachment
